name: web-page-extract
description: Fetch a web page and return cleaned content, metadata, and discovered links.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL to fetch and extract.

format.description: Preferred output format for the extracted page body.

include_links.description: Whether to include normalized links discovered in the page body.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to return in the cleaned content.

ok.description: True when the page was fetched and parsed successfully.

url.description: Original URL requested by the caller.

final_url.description: Final URL after any redirects applied by the fetch layer.

title.description: Best-effort page title derived from title tags or social metadata.

canonical_url.description: Canonical URL declared by the page, resolved against the fetched URL when present.

published_at.description: Best-effort publish timestamp extracted from page metadata.

byline.description: Best-effort author or byline extracted from page metadata.

excerpt.description: Short summary or description extracted from page metadata.

format.description: Output format used for the cleaned page body.

content.description: Cleaned main page content in the requested format.

links.description: Normalized links discovered in the page body when include_links is true.

text.description: Visible link text associated with the discovered URL, when available.

href.description: Absolute URL for the discovered link.

metadata.description: Additional extraction metadata such as truncation state and source size.

ok.description: False when the request or extraction failed.

error.description: Structured error returned by the tool.

details.description: Optional structured context about the failure.
